turns.question: Which companies disclosed exit or restructuring costs under 8-K Item 2.05, and what charges did each expect? Cite the filings.

report.markdown:
Based on the SEC 8-K filings in the selected source (covering January 2025 – March 2026), the following companies disclosed exit or restructuring costs under Item 2.05 with expected charges:

| Company (Ticker) | Filing Date | Restructuring Action | Expected Charges | Key Details | Evidence |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| **Applied Materials (AMAT)** | 2025-10-23 | Workforce reduction (~4% of global workforce) | **$160M – $180M** | Primarily severance & one-time termination benefits (cash) plus non-cash charges; most recognized in Q4 FY2025, plan complete by Q1 FY2026 | [1] |
| **CrowdStrike (CRWD)** | 2025-05-07 | Strategic plan reducing ~500 roles (5% of workforce) | **$36M – $53M** | ~$7M in Q1 FY2026, remainder in Q2 FY2026; ~$19–26M cash (severance, benefits), ~$10–20M non-cash (stock-based comp); substantially complete by end of Q2 FY2026 | [2] |
| **Starbucks (SBUX)** | 2025-09-25 | Store closures & support organization transformation (“Back to Starbucks”) | **~$1.0B** total | ~$150M employee separation, ~$400M asset disposal/impairment, ~$450M lease costs (ROU amortization); ~$400M non-cash, ~$600M cash; majority of closures by end of FY2025 | [1] |
| **Merck (MRK)** | 2025-07-29 | 2025 Restructuring Program (positions, real estate, manufacturing) | **~$3.0B** cumulative pretax | ~60% cash (employee separation, contractual termination), ~40% non-cash (accelerated depreciation); actions largely complete by end of 2027 (manufacturing by 2029); ~$1.7B annual savings by 2027 | [3] |
| **Pfizer (PFE)** | 2025-04-29 | Cost realignment program expansion (SI&A & R&D) | **~$1.6B** through 2027 (program) + **~$600M** through 2026 (R&D simplification) | Primarily cash for severance, digital enablement, implementation; additional savings of ~$1.2B by 2027 and ~$500M R&D savings by 2026 | [4] |
| **Nike (NKE)** | 2026-03-05 | Organizational changes to realign costs | **~$300M** pre-tax for nine months ended Feb 28, 2026 | Primarily employee severance; substantially all recognized in Q3 FY2026; estimates subject to local law assumptions | [5] |

**Limitations:** The SEC filings source covers only Item 1.05 filings plus the latest 8-Ks of the 100 most liquid stocks from Jan 2025–Mar 2026. Other companies may have filed Item 2.05 disclosures outside this set. All figures are company estimates disclosed at filing and are forward-looking; actual charges may differ.
